sections.heading: Command terms: four words that decide a Biology mark
paragraphs: Every question in a Biology paper opens with a command term, and the term is an instruction about structure rather than about content. Students treat these words as interchangeable requests for information. Examiners treat them as specifications. The distance between those two readings is worth several grades over a full paper, and it is the quickest return available on tutoring time because it needs no new biology at all.

State and outline ask for brief, separate items with no development. A student who writes a paragraph in answer to an outline question has spent four minutes earning two marks and will run short of time later in the paper. Describe asks for detailed features without reasons. Explain asks for reasons, and an explanation with no causal link in it scores nothing however accurate the biology. Suggest asks the student to apply biology to unfamiliar material, which means an answer that only repeats taught content cannot be credited, because the mark scheme is looking for application.

Compare and contrast is the term that produces the most wasted writing. It requires both similarities and differences, and it requires them framed as comparisons rather than as two separate descriptions. A script that describes process A for half a page and process B for the other half has not compared anything and typically collects a fraction of the marks. The repair is mechanical: a two-column table in rough, then sentences that carry both halves in each line.

The way to work on this is with the student's own marked script and the published mark scheme side by side on a shared screen. Read the command term, predict what the scheme will want, then open the scheme. After about fifteen of those cycles, students start predicting accurately, and the effect shows up in the next timed paper rather than in the one after it.
bullets: Outline means brief and separate; a paragraph here costs time, not gains marks
Explain requires a stated cause, not an accurate description
Suggest requires application to unseen material, so taught content alone scores nothing
Compare and contrast needs both similarities and differences, framed as comparisons

sections.heading: The scientific investigation, criterion by criterion
paragraphs: The investigation is the component where a parent can see progress most clearly, because it exists as a sequence of drafts. Four criteria, six marks each, twenty-four in total, scaled to a fifth of the final grade. Each criterion has published descriptors, and each has a characteristic way of going wrong that is visible in a first draft to anyone who knows what to look for.

Research design fails on vagueness. A question such as whether temperature affects enzyme activity is not a research question; it is a topic. The marks arrive when the independent variable has a stated range and interval, the dependent variable has a stated method of measurement with units, and the controlled variables are named with the method of control written next to each one. A first draft that reads as a plan rather than a specification is a draft sitting in the lower bands, and that is diagnosable in two minutes.

Data analysis fails on presentation and on uncertainty. Raw data with no processing, graphs without error bars, a statistical test chosen because it was the one the class was taught: each of these caps the criterion. Conclusion fails on overreach, where a student writes that the hypothesis is proven when the data supports a trend within a range. Evaluation fails on generality, where weaknesses are listed as a standard set rather than as the specific limitations this investigation actually had.

A tutor's role here is bounded and should be stated plainly in writing. The tutor may teach the relevant biology, explain what a criterion requires, ask questions about a decision the student has made, and give feedback on one draft in the way the school's own supervisor would. The tutor may not supply sentences, choose the research question, process the data or improve the prose. The student produces every word. Any service offering more than that is offering the student a malpractice finding.
bullets: A research question without a stated range and interval is a topic, not a question
Controlled variables need a named method of control, one per variable
Graphs without uncertainty treatment cap the data analysis criterion
Evaluation marks come from this investigation's specific limitations, not a generic list

sections.heading: A twelve-week evidence log: what should exist on paper by week twelve
paragraphs: Tutoring that works produces documents. Tutoring that does not produces reassurance. The difference is visible by about week four, and a parent who knows what should exist by then can stop an unproductive arrangement a term earlier than they otherwise would. What follows is the artefact trail from a typical twelve-week run on Higher Level Biology, starting from a student sitting around a 4 after a January mock.

Weeks one to three are diagnostic and should feel slow. A full Paper 1B sat cold, scored separately from Part A. One Section B extended response sat under timing and marked against the complete point list, with the points the student missed written out. From those two documents comes a short written diagnosis naming two or three themes and one or two skills. If no written diagnosis exists after three sessions, there is no plan, and the hours after that are being spent on whatever the student mentions at the start of the lesson.

Weeks four to eight are the repair, and the evidence is repeat performance rather than new notes. The same style of question, from a different paper, scored again. A student who earned nine marks on a Section B answer in week two and fifteen on an equivalent question in week seven has moved, and the two marked scripts prove it. Over the same window the investigation should move from research question to collected data, with a draft of the design section read and returned. Weeks nine to twelve are consolidation: full papers, timing, and a score record that either rises or does not.

None of this requires a specialised reporting system or a progress dashboard. It requires the marked scripts kept in one folder in date order. Ask for them at the end of every session. A tutor who cannot produce the last four weeks of marked work on request is not marking, and marking is the part of the job that moves a Biology HL grade.

sections.heading: What actually moves a 4 to a 6 in Biology HL
paragraphs: Grade movement in Biology HL is rarely about covering more content. Students on a 4 have usually met everything on the course at least once. What separates them from students on a 6 is a small, stable set of behaviours, and those behaviours are teachable in a defined number of hours rather than over an open-ended arrangement. Naming them honestly is more useful than any promise about outcomes.

The first is point-counting in extended responses. A student who learns to plan a Section B answer as a list of distinct creditable points before writing a sentence typically gains a visible block of marks within a month. The second is data fluency: error bars, significance, interpolation, and the discipline of quoting a figure from the stem in every data answer. The third is command-term accuracy, which is pure technique. The fourth is the investigation, where moving two criteria from the middle band to the top band is worth a material slice of a fifth of the grade.

The fifth is less comfortable: timing. Higher Level Biology papers are long, and students who run out of time lose marks on questions they could answer. Marked scripts show it as a sharp drop in quality across the final pages, or as blank space. No amount of content teaching fixes that; only sitting full papers against a clock does, which is why a revision block built on past papers is a different purchase from weekly content lessons and should be bought deliberately.

What cannot be promised, and should be treated with real scepticism wherever it is offered, is a specific grade. The honest version is this: these five behaviours are what the marks respond to, they can be worked on in a stated number of sessions, and the score record will show whether they are moving. If it is not moving after six weeks of proper marking, the arrangement is wrong and should change rather than continue.
bullets: Plan Section B answers as a list of distinct points before writing prose
Quote a figure from the question stem in every data-based answer
Treat command terms as structural instructions, not requests for information
Sit full papers against a clock, because timing losses are invisible otherwise

sections.heading: Academic honesty: the line a Biology tutor must not cross
paragraphs: The IB treats work submitted for assessment as the student's own, and a breach is an academic misconduct matter that can cost a Diploma rather than a grade. The scientific investigation is the point of maximum exposure, because it is produced at home, over weeks, with help available from every direction. Parents in the UAE are routinely offered services that cross this line, sometimes openly, at prices that suggest the work is produced to order. One competitor in this market advertises finished internal assessments as a product. That is an integrity breach, and buying it puts the student at risk, not the seller.

The permissible shape of support is well defined and worth having in writing before any money changes hands. A tutor may teach the underlying biology, explain what each criterion requires and in whose words, ask questions that force the student to justify a decision, point at a weakness without correcting it, and read one draft in the same way a school supervisor reads one. That is a substantial amount of help and it is entirely legitimate.

What is not permissible is the tutor supplying text, choosing the research question, performing the data processing, rewriting the prose, or producing a model report for the student to adapt. The practical test is simple and a parent can apply it without any biology: if the sentences in the report are not sentences the student could have produced and can explain under questioning, the work is not the student's own. Ask the student to explain their method and their statistics out loud. If they cannot, the problem is upstream of the grade.

A good tutor makes this easy to audit. Feedback should arrive as written comments on the student's own document with version history intact, so the school can see the sequence of the student's drafts and the tutor's questions. Where a student's school asks for a declaration of outside support, the honest answer is that a tutor taught the content and gave criterion-referenced feedback on one draft. That answer causes nobody any difficulty.
bullets: Keep version history on the investigation document so the drafting sequence is visible
Feedback should be questions and criterion references, never replacement text
The student must be able to explain the method and the statistics out loud
Declare outside support honestly where the school asks for a declaration

sections.heading: The hour an Ajman family gets back by working online
paragraphs: Parents searching for a Biology tutor in Ajman are usually picturing someone arriving at the house. That market exists here, and it is worth describing honestly before explaining why IB Gram does not operate in it. A tutor who travels prices travel into the hour: published UAE rate cards put in-home one-to-one work in a band of roughly AED 180 to 500 an hour, against roughly AED 150 to 300 for a qualified online subject tutor and AED 200 to 450 or more for an examination-level specialist, with a premium tier above that. Those are the figures reported by UAE rate sources including Bestimate's 2026 tutoring-cost tables, not IB Gram's prices.

The second cost is the one nobody prices: supply. Higher Level Biology with a confident grasp of the current guide's investigation criteria is a narrow specialism. Within a twenty-minute drive of Al Mowaihat or Al Jurf, the number of people who do that work well is small, and the ones who do are already full during the January mock window. A family restricted to a drive radius is not choosing the best available Biology HL specialist; it is choosing the best one in a small circle, at the price travel demands.

IB Gram does not offer home visits in the UAE. Home tutoring is a service offered only in India, and every UAE lesson runs one-to-one over live video. On a data-heavy subject that is not a compromise: a shared screen with the actual graph on it, annotated live, is better than two people leaning over one printed page, and the marked script arrives as a file the family keeps rather than a page in a bag. For an Ajman family whose working day ends in Dubai, the practical gain is simpler still. The session starts when the student is home, not when a tutor has crossed the emirate.

The honest limits are worth stating too. Online needs a stable connection, a surface the student can write on, and a household willing to leave them undisturbed for ninety minutes. Where those are missing, online works less well, and that is worth testing in the free trial lesson rather than discovering in week five.

sections.heading: Counting backwards from the May series to the week you are in
paragraphs: Diploma students in the UAE sit the May series, and the examination window is the fixed point everything else hangs from. The dates themselves should be taken from the school's Diploma coordinator or from ibo.org rather than from a tutoring page, because secondary sources circulate inconsistent windows and the registration and upload deadlines differ by school. What does not change is the shape of the run-in, and that shape is what a family can plan against today.

Working backwards: the written papers sit at the end. Before them is a revision window where the only productive activity is timed papers and targeted repair of what those papers expose. Before that sit the school's internal deadlines for the scientific investigation, which usually fall in the first half of the final year and are set by the school rather than by the IB. Before those sits the data collection, which needs laboratory access the student does not control, and which is therefore the step most likely to slip. Before that sits the research question, which is the cheapest thing in the entire sequence to get right and the most expensive to get wrong.

The practical consequence for an Ajman family is that the useful moment to start on the investigation is earlier than it feels. A student who settles a research question in the autumn has a term of slack for a failed experiment. A student who settles it in February has none, and a failed set of readings then costs marks in a component worth a fifth of the grade. For the written papers the pressure runs the other way: starting timed-paper work too early, before content is covered, produces demoralising scores that teach nothing.

Ramadan falls inside the Diploma year and reshapes when revision can happen. School hours shorten, evenings restructure around iftar, and a 17:00 session becomes unworkable for many households while a 21:30 one becomes easy. Sessions should move rather than pause: a student who stops for a month in the final spring loses the window where timed practice matters most. Ask for the shifted slot in advance, because the late evening hours fill quickly across the northern emirates.
bullets: Take exam and results dates from the Diploma coordinator or ibo.org, not from a tutoring site
Investigation deadlines are set inside the school, so they are visible months ahead
Settle the research question in the autumn to leave slack for a failed experiment
Move sessions to post-iftar timings through Ramadan rather than pausing them

process.title: Send the last marked script
process.description: Before any call, send the most recent marked Biology HL paper or mock, and the investigation draft if one exists. A script with a teacher's marks on it tells a specialist more in five minutes than a half-hour conversation about how the student is finding the course.

process.title: Free trial lesson, marked
process.description: One lesson at no cost, with no card details taken. Ask for it to end with a timed question marked against the published scheme. What you are testing is not whether the tutor is pleasant but whether marking comes back with named mark-scheme points on it.

process.title: Written diagnosis
process.description: Within the first three sessions you should receive a short written diagnosis: which themes are weak, which skills are weak, and which component the score record says is costing the most. If that document never appears, the sessions have no plan behind them.

process.title: Fixed slot and a folder
process.description: A regular Gulf Standard Time slot that fits an Ajman evening, and one folder where every marked script is kept in date order. The folder is the record. It is what makes a conversation about value possible in week eight.

process.title: Review at six weeks
process.description: Compare comparable questions from week one and week six. If the score record has not moved and the marking is genuinely happening, the arrangement needs changing rather than extending. A tutor who says this first is a tutor worth keeping.

whyPoints.title: Marking you can read
whyPoints.description: Every piece of written work comes back with the mark scheme's own points named, including the ones the student missed. A tick does not tell you where the mark was. A list of seven required points with three circled does.

whyPoints.title: Specialists, not generalists
whyPoints.description: Higher Level Biology and its investigation criteria are a specific competence, separate from general science teaching. Online delivery means an Ajman family is choosing from people who do this subject at this level, rather than from those within driving distance.

whyPoints.description: Support is structured as teaching, questioning and criterion-referenced feedback on the student's own drafts. The student produces every word. That boundary is stated in writing before the first session, which protects the Diploma as well as the grade.

faqs.question: What should I ask for at the end of a trial lesson with a Biology HL tutor in Ajman?
faqs.answer: Ask for one timed question marked against the published mark scheme, with the scheme's points listed and the missed ones named. That single artefact tells you more than any conversation. A tutor who marks properly will produce it without hesitation; one who returns a page of ticks and a verbal summary is not doing the part of the job that moves a Higher Level grade. Also ask what they would work on first and why, and listen for whether the answer refers to the script you sent or to generic revision advice. The free trial is one lesson, with no card details required.

faqs.question: Is there still a Paper 3 in IB Biology at Higher Level?
faqs.answer: Not in the guide currently being assessed. The Biology course was restructured and the grade is now built from two written papers plus the student's own scientific investigation, which carries a fifth of the final mark. This matters practically because second-hand revision guides and question banks written for the older three-paper course are still widely sold in the UAE, and a student practising Paper 3 style questions is spending hours on a component that no longer exists. Confirm with your school's Diploma coordinator which guide your child's cohort sits before buying any material, and buy nothing that does not state its edition.

faqs.question: How do I tell whether my child's Biology problem is content or technique?
faqs.answer: Look at the distribution of marks on a recent script rather than the total. If whole questions are blank or scored near zero, the content was not covered and teaching is needed. If almost every question has some marks but few have full marks, the content is largely there and the losses are technique: command terms, point-counting in extended responses, and data handling. The second pattern is much more common at Higher Level and much faster to repair. A proper diagnosis separates Paper 1A from Paper 1B scores, because coverage gaps and data skills are different problems with different fixes.

faqs.question: Can a tutor help with my child's Biology scientific investigation without breaking IB rules?
faqs.answer: Yes, within a clear boundary. A tutor may teach the relevant biology, explain what each of the four criteria requires, question a decision the student has made, point at a weakness without correcting it, and give feedback on one draft as a school supervisor would. A tutor may not supply sentences, select the research question, process the data or rewrite the prose. The test is whether the student can explain every choice and every calculation out loud under questioning. Keep version history on the document so the sequence of the student's own drafts is visible to the school.

faqs.question: How many marks is the Biology investigation worth and how is it split?
faqs.answer: The scientific investigation carries a fifth of the final Biology grade at both levels and is marked out of twenty-four across four criteria worth six marks each: research design, data analysis, conclusion and evaluation. Most losses sit in the first and last of those rather than in the biology itself. Research design marks need a quantified range and interval for the variable being changed and a named method of control for each controlled variable. Evaluation marks need weaknesses specific to this experiment, with realistic improvements, rather than a generic list that would fit any investigation.

faqs.question: My daughter writes a full page on Paper 2 Section B and still scores half marks. Why?
faqs.answer: Because the mark scheme awards distinct creditable points, and a full page can contain three of them restated in different words. Length is not the currency; separate, specific, scheme-matching points are. The repair is to plan the answer as a numbered list of points before writing a sentence, aiming for more points than the question's mark allocation, then writing each as one clear statement with its causal link included. Students who learn this typically show a visible gain on comparable questions within a month, and the two marked scripts prove it happened.

faqs.question: Does an Ajman student need a tutor based in the UAE for Biology HL?
faqs.answer: No, and insisting on it narrows the choice considerably. What matters is that the tutor knows the current Biology guide, marks against published schemes and teaches at the right hour in Gulf Standard Time. Higher Level Biology with real command of the investigation criteria is a narrow specialism, and restricting the search to people living within driving distance of Al Nuaimiya or Al Rawda means choosing from a small pool at the price travel demands. Where no specialist is free in a requested slot, you should be told that plainly rather than offered a general science tutor instead.

faqs.question: What does Paper 1B test that revision guides do not cover?
faqs.answer: Paper 1B is built on unseen data: graphs, tables, error bars, scales and figures the student has never met. It tests interpretation rather than recall, so a student can revise every theme thoroughly and still score poorly. The skills involved are specific and learnable: quoting a figure from the stem in every answer, reading an axis carefully, distinguishing correlation from causation, and knowing what an error bar permits a conclusion to say. For a student sitting around a 4 who already knows the content, this is usually the highest-yield area to work on first.

faqs.question: How long before the May series should Biology HL sessions start?
faqs.answer: For written papers, a twelve-week run of timed practice and targeted repair before the series is the common shape, and starting much earlier tends to produce demoralising scores on content not yet covered. For the scientific investigation the answer is the opposite: start in the autumn of the final year, because the research question is cheap to fix early and expensive to fix late, and a failed set of readings needs a term of slack. Take the exact examination and results dates from your school's Diploma coordinator or from ibo.org rather than from any tutoring website.

faqs.question: Do private tutors working with Ajman families need a permit?
faqs.answer: Individuals providing private tuition in the UAE need a private tutor work permit from MoHRE, introduced under Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023. The permit is granted free of charge for two years, and eligible applicants include registered school teachers, government and private-sector employees, unemployed residents, university students and school students aged fifteen to eighteen. People tutoring without one are subject to fines and penalties under the applicable laws; no fine schedule is published, so treat any specific figure you are quoted with caution. Applications go through the MoHRE website, smart app and e-services system.

faqs.question: Can my child's own Biology teacher tutor them privately in Ajman?
faqs.answer: It is a question to put to the school before the money, not after. Abu Dhabi's regulator has professional-ethics rules barring school staff from paid private tutoring of students enrolled at their own school, and the MoHRE permit carries a code of conduct that also addresses serving students affiliated with the tutor's own school. Ajman schools sit under the federal Ministry of Education, so the school's own policy and the permit conditions are what govern it. There is also a practical objection: the teacher who set the work is not the best person to show a student how a different examiner reads it.

faqs.question: Who regulates the school my child attends if we live in Ajman?
faqs.answer: Private schools in Ajman are supervised by the federal Ministry of Education, as are those in Umm Al Quwain and Fujairah. Dubai schools answer to KHDA, Abu Dhabi and Al Ain schools to ADEK, Sharjah schools to the Sharjah Private Education Authority and Ras Al Khaimah schools to its Department of Knowledge. The distinction matters for Ajman families because many send children across the Sharjah border, which puts the school under a different authority with its own fee and curriculum approvals. The complete regulator map is published on the UAE government portal at u.ae.

faqs.question: Will Biology HL count towards UAE Ministry of Education equivalency?
faqs.answer: Equivalency is assessed by the Ministry of Education against published requirements per curriculum, and the British-track rules are the ones published clearly: five accredited GCSE or IGCSE subjects at no less than grade E or 3, with Arabic and Islamic education excluded from that count, plus one A-Level at E or two AS-Levels. For the IB, no points threshold should be quoted from a tutoring page; verify it on moe.gov.ae or with the attestation authority directly. Equivalency is a process the family completes with the ministry, not something a tutoring platform performs or can speed up.

faqs.question: Does IB Gram send a Biology tutor to a house in Ajman?
faqs.answer: No. IB Gram does not offer home visits anywhere in the UAE; home tutoring is a service offered only in India. Every UAE lesson is one-to-one over live video, on Gulf Standard Time. For a data-heavy subject this suits the work: the actual graph sits on a shared screen and is annotated live, and the marked script arrives as a file the family keeps in date order rather than a page in a school bag. It also means an Ajman family is choosing a Higher Level Biology specialist rather than whoever covers science within a short drive.

faqs.question: What happens if no Higher Level Biology specialist is free in our slot?
faqs.answer: You should be told so directly. Higher Level Biology with command of the current investigation criteria is a narrow specialism, and demand concentrates in the January mock window and the weeks before the May series, when late-evening slots across the northern emirates fill first. The honest options are a different time, a short wait, or a specialist in a nearby time zone whose hours still work for an Ajman evening. What should never happen is a general science tutor being presented as a Higher Level Biology specialist because the slot was available.

faqs.question: Can one tutor take Biology HL and a second Higher Level science for the same student?
faqs.answer: Sometimes, and it is worth asking, because a student carrying two Higher Level sciences has a timetable problem as well as a subject problem. Some tutors genuinely cover Biology and Chemistry at Higher Level; many are strong in one and adequate in the other, which produces one good hour and one mediocre one. Ask for a marked script in each subject during the trial and compare them. If the marking quality differs noticeably, split the subjects between two specialists and accept the extra scheduling work rather than paying specialist rates for generalist marking.

ajman/ib-dp-biology-hl-tutor.closingHeading: Start with the script, not the sales call
ajman/ib-dp-biology-hl-tutor.closingBody: Find the last Biology HL paper the school marked and the investigation draft if one exists, and send them before anything else happens. A specialist reading those two documents can tell you in a few minutes whether the problem is coverage, technique, data skills or the investigation, and roughly how many hours each of those takes to repair. Then take the free trial lesson and ask for one timed question marked against the published scheme. Lessons run one-to-one over live video on Gulf Standard Time, timed for an Ajman evening, and every session leaves a marked script behind. If the score record is not moving by week six, change the arrangement rather than extending it.

ajman/ib-dp-economics-hl-tutor.tutorsIntro: The tutors listed below teach IB Economics at Higher Level: the four units, the nine key concepts, the quantitative content that only Higher Level students sit, and the three-commentary portfolio. Book the free trial and bring a marked Paper 2 to it.

intro.heading: Why able writers lose marks in Higher Level Economics
paragraphs: Economics attracts the students who read the business pages and argue well at dinner. That is exactly why the subject surprises them. A Higher Level Economics paper is not an essay competition. It is a technical examination with a rigid mark allocation, and a candidate who writes four elegant paragraphs about inflation without drawing a single diagram, defining a single term or reaching a judgement has produced something an examiner cannot reward. The marks are there for specific, nameable acts: a definition, a correctly labelled diagram, an explained causal chain, a figure quoted from the extract, and an evaluative conclusion that actually decides something.

At Higher Level there is a third paper that Standard Level candidates never see, and it is where the grade is usually won or lost. The policy paper asks for calculations and a reasoned policy recommendation, drawing on the quantitative content reserved for Higher Level: multipliers, elasticity arithmetic, the Lorenz curve and Gini coefficient, balance-of-payments figures, terms of trade. Students who have treated Economics as a discursive subject for eighteen months arrive at that paper having never practised arithmetic under timing. The repair is mechanical and it is fast, but it has to be deliberate.

This page is organised around the assessment rather than around a pitch. It explains what each component asks for, how long it lasts and what share of the grade it carries; which diagrams examiners expect to see and how they must be labelled; how the three-commentary portfolio works, including the rules about units, sources and key concepts that cause more lost marks than any economics does; what the Higher Level quantitative content actually contains; and how the command-term ladder from define to evaluate maps onto the mark allocations. By the end you should be able to look at your child's last marked paper and see which of those things is missing.

A note for Ajman households specifically. Ajman's own Diploma provision is small, so a substantial number of Higher Level Economics students here are registered at schools in Sharjah or Dubai and cross an emirate border every morning. That has two consequences. The first is scheduling: with a parent commuting and a school run over the border, a realistic weekday session starts after 19:00, and the late-evening slots fill first across the northern emirates. The second is choice of tutor. Economics at Higher Level, with genuine command of the policy paper, is a narrow specialism, and the number of people who teach it well within a short drive of Al Nuaimiya or Al Rawda is small.

Online delivery answers both. The lesson starts when the student is home rather than when a tutor has crossed Ajman, and the family selects from people who teach Higher Level Economics rather than from those who live nearby. For a subject whose core skill is drawing and annotating diagrams, a shared screen with a drawing surface on it is a better teaching instrument than a notebook on a kitchen table, because the diagram can be built, broken and rebuilt in front of the student and saved afterwards.

ajman/ib-dp-economics-hl-tutor.programmesIntro: Higher Level Economics is taken by students arriving from several different directions, and each arrival brings a predictable weakness. The notes below say what that weakness normally is for an Ajman or Sharjah student and what the first weeks should address.

programmes.name: Diploma Programme
programmes.description: Higher Level Economics covers four units: an introduction to economics, microeconomics, macroeconomics and the global economy. Higher Level candidates study additional quantitative material inside those units and sit a third paper built on it. Assessment is three written papers plus a portfolio of three commentaries written on published news articles, with the papers carrying the large majority of the grade.
programmes.countryNote: Economics is one of the most commonly chosen Higher Level subjects in UAE schools, partly because so many families here work in trade, logistics, property and finance, and students arrive with real intuition about exchange rates, oil prices and construction cycles. That intuition helps with the portfolio and hinders the papers, where an examiner rewards the textbook mechanism rather than the student's own commercial sense.

programmes.name: Middle Years Programme into Economics
programmes.description: MYP Individuals and Societies builds research and argument, marked against criteria rather than against a mark scheme with discrete points. Students come out able to construct a case and unused to the idea that a diagram without axis labels earns nothing, or that a two-mark definition has a required form.
programmes.countryNote: Ajman Academy students moving up from MYP into Higher Level Economics usually need the first half-term spent on technical convention rather than content: how an examiner expects a diagram drawn, what a definition must contain, and how a mark allocation tells you how long an answer should be. That convention work is quick and it changes scores immediately.

programmes.name: IGCSE Economics or Business Studies into Higher Level
programmes.description: Many students enter Higher Level Economics from Cambridge IGCSE Economics, from Business Studies, or from neither. The ones arriving from Business Studies are the most exposed, because they have learned to answer with application to a company rather than with a model, and Higher Level Economics is a modelling subject.
programmes.countryNote: In the northern emirates the common pattern is a student who sat IGCSE at a Sharjah or Ajman British-curriculum school and started the Diploma without having drawn a market diagram since Year 10. Six weeks of diagram drill, done properly against examiner expectations, closes that gap before macroeconomics starts and makes the rest of the course far cheaper to teach.

programmes.name: Where Higher Level Economics leads
programmes.description: Higher Level Economics is a common entry requirement signal for economics, business, finance and public policy degrees, and the quantitative content in the Higher Level papers is the part that university admissions treat as evidence of readiness. Many economics degrees also expect a mathematics course at Higher Level, which is a separate conversation from this one.
programmes.countryNote: Students in the UAE applying to universities in the Emirates, the United Kingdom or North America should check mathematics requirements alongside Economics, because several economics programmes specify a particular mathematics route rather than any Higher Level mathematics. Requirements should be read on each university's own admissions page rather than taken from a tutoring site.

ajman/ib-dp-economics-hl-tutor.subjectsIntro: Below are the parts of the Higher Level Economics course where marked scripts most often show losses, with what the loss looks like on paper. Several are Higher Level only, which is why a Standard Level revision guide is a poor investment for a Higher Level candidate.

subjects.name: Demand, supply and market equilibrium
subjects.description: The foundation diagram set, and the one students draw sloppily because they learned it first. Missing axis labels, unlabelled equilibrium points and curves shifted without a stated cause are the standard losses. Every later diagram inherits these habits, so this is the cheapest thing in the course to fix properly.

subjects.name: Elasticities and the arithmetic behind them
subjects.description: Price, income and cross elasticity involve calculation as well as interpretation, and Higher Level questions ask for the number and its meaning. Students lose marks by computing correctly and then failing to say what the value implies for a firm or a government.

subjects.name: Market failure and government intervention
subjects.description: Externality diagrams carry welfare loss areas that must be identified and shaded, not merely mentioned. Indirect taxes and subsidies at Higher Level require incidence calculations. Scripts commonly describe the policy and never show the welfare effect the diagram exists to demonstrate.

subjects.name: Aggregate demand, aggregate supply and the multiplier
subjects.description: The Keynesian multiplier and marginal propensities are Higher Level content and appear as calculation. The commonest loss is a correct multiplier value used in no further sentence, when the mark scheme wants the resulting change in output stated and interpreted.

subjects.name: Inflation, unemployment and the Phillips curve
subjects.description: Measurement matters here: constructing a price index, reading unemployment data, and the Higher Level treatment of short-run and long-run Phillips curves. Answers lose marks by discussing the trade-off without drawing it or without naming the type of unemployment under discussion.

subjects.name: Inequality, poverty and the Gini coefficient
subjects.description: The Lorenz curve and the Gini coefficient are Higher Level content and are routinely examined as interpretation of a figure. Students who can describe inequality in words but cannot read a Lorenz curve lose a reliable block of marks in Paper 3.

subjects.name: International trade, protectionism and exchange rates
subjects.description: Tariff diagrams have several areas to identify and each one is a separate mark. At Higher Level, calculations on tariff revenue, consumer and producer surplus and the terms of trade appear, as does the Marshall-Lerner condition and the J-curve effect.

subjects.name: Balance of payments and the current account
subjects.description: Higher Level candidates are asked to work with balance-of-payments accounts numerically and to explain the relationship between the current and financial accounts. This is a favourite source of Paper 3 calculation and it is almost never practised enough before a mock.

subjects.name: Economic development and sustainability
subjects.description: The global economy unit rewards specific country evidence and precise indicator names. Generic development discussion scores poorly; a named policy, a named country and a figure score well. Students in the UAE often have strong material here from the region if they are taught to use it as evidence.

subjects.name: The three-commentary portfolio
subjects.description: Three commentaries of up to 800 words each, on three different units, using three different published sources and three different key concepts. The commonest losses are administrative rather than economic: a source that breaks the recency rule, two commentaries on the same unit, or a word count overrun.

sections.heading: What a Higher Level Economics grade is actually made of
paragraphs: Higher Level candidates sit three written papers and submit a portfolio. Standard Level candidates sit two papers and submit the same kind of portfolio with a larger share of the grade attached to it. Knowing the shape matters because it tells you where tutoring hours have the greatest effect, and because a family buying revision material needs to buy for the right level: a Standard Level guide omits a third of what a Higher Level candidate is examined on.

Paper 1 is the extended-response paper. Candidates choose one question from a selection and answer it in two parts, the first asking for explanation and the second for evaluation. It lasts an hour and a quarter, which sounds generous and is not, because a strong answer contains definitions, at least one fully labelled diagram, a developed causal chain and a judgement. Scripts that run out of time almost always do so because the student wrote an introduction of no value for six minutes.

Paper 2 is data response. Candidates work from extracts and a data set, and the marks are distributed across short definitions, a diagram question, explanation questions, and a longer evaluation that must draw on the material provided. The single most common loss on this paper is an answer that would be identical if the extracts had never been printed. Examiners look for figures and phrases lifted from the text and used as evidence.

Paper 3 is sat only by Higher Level candidates and is the policy paper. It contains compulsory questions mixing calculation with explanation and a recommendation, drawing on the quantitative material reserved for Higher Level. It carries a substantial share of the Higher Level grade and it is the component that the weekly content lesson tends to neglect, because arithmetic feels like a mathematics problem rather than an economics one. The portfolio of three commentaries completes the grade and is marked internally against the published rubric before moderation.

sections.heading: Paper 3 is the paper that decides Higher Level Economics
paragraphs: If a Higher Level Economics student is sitting on a 4 or a 5 and writes well, the probability is high that the policy paper is the problem. It is the only component where a student can lose marks to arithmetic, and the only one that asks for a recommendation defended with a number. Students who have spent eighteen months writing about the economy find the format alien, and the alienation shows up as blank space rather than as wrong answers.

The content drawn on is the Higher Level quantitative material: calculating and interpreting elasticities, the Keynesian multiplier and marginal propensities, index numbers, tariff and subsidy effects with welfare areas quantified, consumer and producer surplus, the Lorenz curve and Gini coefficient, balance-of-payments accounts and the terms of trade. None of it is difficult mathematics. All of it is unfamiliar if it has only been met once, in a lesson, a year ago.

Two technical habits account for most of the recoverable marks. The first is setting out working so that method marks survive a slip: a student who writes the formula, substitutes the figures and then miscalculates still collects marks, while a student who writes only a wrong number collects nothing. The second is answering the second half of every question. A calculation is almost always followed by a demand to interpret, explain or recommend, and an unanswered interpretation is the most frequent single omission on the paper.

The recommendation questions are marked like a policy argument rather than like an essay. The examiner wants the policy named, the mechanism explained, the likely magnitude discussed with reference to the data provided, the limitations acknowledged, and a decision reached. A student who lists three policies and never chooses between them has written the structure of a Standard Level answer and will be marked accordingly. Timed practice is what fixes this, and it works quickly: six to eight properly marked papers typically moves a student more than a term of content revision.

sections.heading: Diagrams are marks: what examiners require on the page
paragraphs: Economics is a diagram subject and most students draw badly for a simple reason: nobody ever marked their diagrams line by line. A diagram in an Economics answer is not an illustration of the argument. It is part of the argument, and it carries its own marks, which are awarded for things that are mechanical and learnable. Axes labelled with the correct variables. Curves labelled. Original and new equilibrium both marked. The direction of a shift shown. Relevant areas identified and, where welfare is in question, shaded and named.

The habit that costs the most marks is drawing the diagram and then writing an argument that never refers to it. An examiner reading a correct diagram and a paragraph that does not mention any point on it cannot award the explanation marks that the diagram was supposed to support. The fix is a sentence pattern the student uses every time: state what shifts, state why it shifts, name the movement from the first labelled point to the second, and state the effect on price and quantity using the labels on the page.

Different parts of the course carry different diagram risks. Market diagrams suffer from carelessness. Externality diagrams suffer from unshaded welfare loss. Tariff diagrams have several distinct areas and students conflate them. Aggregate demand and supply diagrams suffer from inconsistent axis labelling, with students writing price rather than the general price level and output rather than real output. Each of those is a two-minute correction that is worth a mark every time it appears in an examination.

Practising this online is straightforward and arguably better than on paper, because a shared drawing surface lets the tutor build the diagram with the student, erase one label and ask what breaks, and save the finished version into a file the student revises from. A folder of the student's own correctly labelled diagrams, built over a term, is a better revision resource than any published set.

sections.heading: The portfolio: three commentaries, and the rules that cost marks
paragraphs: The internally assessed portfolio is three commentaries of up to 800 words each, written on published news articles, and it is the only part of the Economics grade a student controls completely. It is also where marks are lost for reasons that have nothing to do with economics. The rules are administrative: three different units of the course, three different published sources, three different key concepts, and articles recent enough to satisfy the recency requirement at the time each commentary is written. A student who writes two commentaries on macroeconomics has capped the portfolio before a single piece of analysis is read.

Within those rules, the marks go to analysis rather than to summary. A weak commentary paraphrases the article and adds a diagram. A strong one takes one narrow economic question raised by the article, applies the relevant model with a labelled diagram, evaluates the analysis honestly within the word limit, and uses the key concept as a lens rather than as a label dropped into the introduction. Eight hundred words is short, which means the single most valuable editorial skill is cutting the article summary down to two or three sentences.

Article choice is where a week gets wasted. A piece that reports an event without any economic mechanism to analyse cannot be rescued by good writing. The test to apply before starting is whether the article lets the student draw a specific diagram and explain a specific causal chain. An article about a tariff, a subsidy, a price control, a central bank decision or an exchange rate movement usually passes that test. An article about a company's results usually does not, because it leads to business analysis rather than economics.

Support here is bounded, and the boundary should be in writing. A tutor may teach the economics, explain the rubric and its criteria, say whether an article permits analysis, and give feedback on the student's own draft in the way the school's own teacher does. A tutor may not choose the articles, supply paragraphs, rewrite the student's prose or produce a model commentary to be adapted. The student's own work is what is being assessed, and anything else is a malpractice exposure for the student rather than for whoever sold the service.

sections.heading: Command terms and the evaluation ladder
paragraphs: Every Economics question is built on a command term, and the term tells the candidate which level of response is being paid for. Define, list, calculate and state sit at the bottom and ask for recall or arithmetic with no development. Explain, analyse, suggest and distinguish sit in the middle and require a mechanism: something causes something, which causes something else. Evaluate, discuss, examine, justify and to what extent sit at the top and require a judgement supported by the analysis already given.

The characteristic failure at Higher Level is treating a top-level term as a middle-level one. A student asked to evaluate monetary policy writes a thorough explanation of how interest rates affect aggregate demand and stops. The economics is correct and the answer is capped, because nothing has been weighed and nothing has been decided. Evaluation marks need the conditions under which the policy works, the conditions under which it does not, some reference to magnitude or time lag, and a conclusion that commits.

A reliable structure helps more than any list of connectives. For an evaluation question: define the terms being used, explain the mechanism with a labelled diagram, give the strongest argument on the other side with its own mechanism, identify what the answer depends on, and conclude by saying which way the balance falls and why. Students resist concluding because committing feels risky. In mark-scheme terms, refusing to commit is the risk.

Definitions deserve a separate word. Short definition questions are the most reliable marks on Paper 2, and they are frequently lost to vagueness. A definition should name the category the term belongs to and the feature that distinguishes it, in one sentence, using the syllabus wording where the syllabus has wording. Students who learn thirty definitions precisely, in the course's own language, pick up marks on every paper for a few hours of work.

Explain and analyse need a causal chain, not a description
Evaluate, discuss and to what extent need a judgement that commits

sections.heading: What the market charges, and the hour an Ajman family gets back
paragraphs: Families searching for an Economics tutor in Ajman usually begin by picturing someone at the dining table. That market is real and it has a price. Published UAE rate sources, including Bestimate's 2026 tutoring cost tables, put in-home one-to-one tuition at roughly AED 180 to 500 an hour with travel priced in, qualified online subject tutors at roughly AED 150 to 300, examination-level specialists at roughly AED 200 to 450 or more, and a premium named tier above that. Budget providers advertise from well below those bands. Those are market figures from published sources, not IB Gram prices.

For Higher Level Economics the supply question matters more than the rate. A tutor who can teach the policy paper, mark a Paper 2 evaluation against the published scheme and advise on portfolio article choice is a narrow specialism. Within a short drive of Al Mowaihat or Al Jurf there are few such people, and they are already committed in the weeks before mocks. A family restricted to a driving radius is not selecting the best available Higher Level Economics specialist; it is selecting the best one nearby, and paying a travel premium for the privilege.

IB Gram does not offer home visits in the UAE. Home tutoring is offered only in India, and every UAE lesson is one-to-one over live video. For a diagram subject that is a genuine advantage rather than a concession: the diagram is built on a shared surface, labels can be removed to test understanding, and the finished version is saved into the student's own folder. The scheduling gain is plainer still. For a household where a parent returns from Dubai at 19:00, the lesson starts when the student is ready rather than when a tutor has crossed two emirates.

The honest limitations are worth saying. Online needs a stable connection, somewhere the student can draw, and ninety undisturbed minutes. Where a household cannot provide those, online delivery works less well, and the free trial lesson is the moment to find that out rather than week five of a paid arrangement.

sections.heading: Permits, regulators and the questions to ask before paying
paragraphs: Private tutoring in the UAE is a permitted activity with conditions, not an unregulated one, and the position is clearer than most tutoring websites suggest. Individuals giving private lessons need a private tutor work permit from the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation, introduced under Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023. The permit is granted free of charge for two years. Eligible applicants include teachers registered at government or private schools, employees in the government and private sectors, unemployed residents, university students and school students aged fifteen to eighteen. Applications are made through the MoHRE website, smart app and e-services system.

Two things follow for a parent. The first is that a tutor charging for lessons should be able to say whether they hold the permit, and anyone operating without one is subject to fines and penalties under the applicable laws. No fine schedule is published, so a specific figure quoted at you is not a verified figure. The second is that a tutoring business with premises and staff is a different legal object from an individual tutor, requiring an educational services permit from the relevant emirate authority. No tutoring platform should describe itself as approved by a regulator unless it holds the specific permit and can show the number.

School regulation is separate and emirate by emirate. Ajman's private schools sit under the federal Ministry of Education, alongside those in Umm Al Quwain and Fujairah. Dubai's answer to KHDA, Abu Dhabi's and Al Ain's to ADEK, Sharjah's to the Sharjah Private Education Authority, and Ras Al Khaimah's to its Department of Knowledge. Sharjah's and Ras Al Khaimah's authorities approve curricula, fees and assessment methods as well as inspecting, which is worth knowing for an Ajman family whose child crosses the border to school each day.

One further rule matters where a family is considering the child's own teacher. Abu Dhabi's regulator has professional-ethics rules barring school staff from paid private tutoring of students at their own school, and the MoHRE permit code of conduct addresses the same conflict. Ajman schools answer to the federal ministry, so the school's own policy and the permit conditions are what apply; ask the school in writing before any arrangement, because the awkwardness of asking afterwards is considerably greater.

process.title: Send a marked Paper 2
process.description: A data-response script with a teacher's marks on it is the most informative document in the subject. It shows whether definitions are precise, whether the extracts were used as evidence, whether diagrams carry labels, and whether the long evaluation reached a judgement. Send it before any conversation.

process.title: Free trial lesson with one marked question
process.description: One lesson at no cost and no card details, ending with a timed question marked against the published scheme. For Economics, ask specifically for a diagram to be marked line by line. That is the fastest available test of whether the tutor knows what an examiner credits.

process.title: Decide which of the three jobs you are buying
process.description: Content and diagrams, the Paper 3 quantitative block, or portfolio process coaching. These need different hours and different sequencing. A single open-ended weekly arrangement tends to drift into whatever the student mentions first and leaves the policy paper untouched.

process.title: Set the slot and the portfolio calendar
process.description: A fixed Gulf Standard Time slot that works for an Ajman evening, plus the school's own internal commentary deadlines written down. The portfolio deadlines are set inside the school and are visible months ahead, which makes them the easiest part of the year to plan around.

process.title: Review against the mark record
process.description: After six weeks, compare equivalent questions from the start and from the most recent session. Economics scores move visibly when diagram and evaluation technique improves. If the record is flat and the marking is genuinely happening, change the arrangement rather than extending it.

whyPoints.title: The policy paper taken seriously
whyPoints.description: Paper 3 is the component weekly lessons most often neglect, and it carries a large share of the Higher Level grade. Sessions on it are timed from the first minute, because the paper's difficulty is pace and format rather than conceptual depth.

whyPoints.title: Diagrams marked line by line
whyPoints.description: Axis labels, curve labels, both equilibria, shift direction and shaded welfare areas each carry marks. Work comes back with those marked individually rather than with a tick on the figure, so the student can see where the mark actually sat.

whyPoints.title: Portfolio help that stays inside the rules
whyPoints.description: Article suitability, rubric requirements, unit and key-concept spread, word count and source dates, all checked. The student chooses the articles and writes every word, with written feedback on their own document so the school can see the sequence.

whyPoints.title: Specialists rather than proximity
whyPoints.description: Online delivery means an Ajman family chooses from tutors who teach Higher Level Economics, not from those who live within a short drive of Al Rawda. For a subject with a Higher Level only paper, that distinction decides the quality of the hour.

whyPoints.title: Market rates quoted, not invented
whyPoints.description: The AED bands on this page come from published UAE rate sources with the year attached and are presented as the market, not as our price list. Where the honest answer is fewer paid hours and more timed past papers, that is what you will be told.

whyPoints.title: Scheduling that matches a northern emirates evening
whyPoints.description: Later weekday starts for households commuting to Dubai or Sharjah, weekend mornings during mock and portfolio windows, and post-iftar slots through Ramadan instead of a month's pause in the period that matters most.

faqs.question: What is Paper 3 in IB Economics and do Standard Level students sit it?
faqs.answer: Paper 3 is the policy paper and only Higher Level candidates sit it. It lasts an hour and three quarters, contains compulsory questions, and mixes calculation with explanation and a policy recommendation drawn from the quantitative content reserved for Higher Level: multipliers, elasticity arithmetic, tariff and welfare areas, Lorenz curves and Gini coefficients, balance-of-payments figures and terms of trade. It carries a substantial share of the Higher Level grade. Because it is the only component involving arithmetic, it is the one most often under-practised, and it is usually the fastest place to recover marks for a student writing well but scoring poorly.

faqs.question: Why does my son write good Economics essays and still get a 4 at Higher Level?
faqs.answer: Almost always because the marks are not where he is putting the effort. A Higher Level answer earns credit for defined terms, a fully labelled diagram referred to inside the prose, a causal chain, and an evaluation that commits to a judgement. Elegant discursive writing without those features is unrewardable. Look at his last marked script: if diagrams are absent or unlabelled, if the extracts are never quoted on Paper 2, or if long answers describe rather than decide, that is the diagnosis. Each of those is technique rather than knowledge, and technique moves faster than content.

faqs.question: How are the Economics commentaries structured and how long can each one be?
faqs.answer: The portfolio is three commentaries, each up to 800 words, written on published news articles. Each must draw on a different unit of the course, use a different published source, and be built around a different key concept, with articles recent enough to meet the recency requirement when written. Marks reward analysis rather than summary: one narrow economic question, the relevant model with a labelled diagram, honest evaluation inside the word limit. The administrative rules cause more lost marks than the economics does, so the spread across units, sources and concepts should be planned before the first commentary is started.

faqs.question: Which key concepts does IB Economics use and do they appear in the exams?
faqs.answer: The course is built on nine key concepts: scarcity, choice, efficiency, equity, economic well-being, sustainability, change, interdependence and intervention. They are not a separate topic to revise; they are lenses the course uses to connect content, and each portfolio commentary must be built around a different one. In the written papers they shape how questions are framed rather than being examined by name, so the practical value for a student is as a planning tool: asking which concept a question is really about often reveals the evaluation line the mark scheme is looking for.

faqs.question: My daughter keeps losing marks on Economics diagrams. What is she doing wrong?
faqs.answer: Usually one of four things. Axes labelled loosely, so price and output appear where the general price level and real output are required. Curves or equilibria unlabelled, so the examiner cannot see what moved. A shift drawn with no stated cause. Or the diagram drawn correctly and then never mentioned in the written answer, which forfeits the explanation marks it was meant to support. Ask for one diagram to be marked line by line in a trial lesson. Students usually fix all four habits within a fortnight once they see the marks separated out.

faqs.question: What does evaluate actually require in an Economics answer?
faqs.answer: A judgement, supported by analysis already given. The marks need the conditions under which the policy or effect holds, the conditions under which it does not, some consideration of magnitude or time lag, and a conclusion that states which way the balance falls and why. A thorough explanation with no weighing is the commonest capped answer at Higher Level. Students resist committing because it feels risky; in mark-scheme terms the refusal to commit is the risk. A structure that always ends with a stated decision adds marks across every paper that carries an evaluation question.

faqs.question: How many Economics sessions does a Higher Level student in Ajman usually need?
faqs.answer: It depends which of three jobs you are buying. Content and diagram work tends to run as a weekly slot across a term or more, following the school's own sequence. The Paper 3 quantitative block is short and intensive, commonly six to eight timed and properly marked papers, which is often the highest-return purchase for a student already writing well. Portfolio coaching is a handful of sessions timed to the school's internal commentary deadlines. Many Ajman families start weekly, add the Paper 3 block before mocks, and schedule portfolio sessions separately.

faqs.question: Can a tutor choose my child's Economics commentary articles?
faqs.answer: No, and a tutor who offers to is creating a problem for the student rather than solving one. The portfolio is internally assessed work that must be the student's own, which includes the selection of the articles and every word of the writing. What a tutor may legitimately do is teach the relevant economics, explain what the rubric requires, say whether a chosen article actually permits economic analysis before a week is spent on it, and give feedback on the student's own draft as the school's teacher would. Keep version history on the document so the drafting sequence is visible.

faqs.question: Is Higher Level Economics or Higher Level Business Management the better choice?
faqs.answer: They assess different things and suit different students. Economics is a modelling subject: diagrams, mechanisms, quantitative policy analysis, and a Higher Level paper requiring calculation. Business Management is applied and case-based, built around a pre-released case study and tools applied to real organisations. A student who enjoys abstraction and is comfortable with arithmetic usually does better in Economics; a student who reasons well about organisations and people often does better in Business Management. Check the entry requirements of the degrees under consideration on each university's own admissions pages, because some economics programmes specify subjects explicitly.

faqs.question: Does Higher Level Economics require Higher Level mathematics as well?
faqs.answer: Not for the Economics course itself. The Higher Level quantitative content is arithmetic and interpretation rather than advanced mathematics, and a competent Standard Level mathematics student can handle all of it with practice. University entry is a separate question: a number of economics degrees specify a mathematics requirement, and some specify which mathematics route they expect. That should be read on each university's own admissions page rather than taken from any tutoring site, because the requirements differ between institutions and between countries and they change between admission cycles.

faqs.question: Do Ajman students sit Economics exams in May or November?
faqs.answer: Schools in the UAE run the northern hemisphere timetable and their Diploma candidates sit the May series. The precise examination window, the registration deadlines and the results dates should be taken from your school's Diploma coordinator or from ibo.org, because secondary sources circulate inconsistent windows and internal deadlines differ between schools. What is stable and plannable is the shape of the run-in: portfolio commentaries spread across the course, mocks in the new year, then a window where only timed papers and targeted repair produce any gain.

faqs.question: Can Economics lessons move to later timings during Ramadan in Ajman?
faqs.answer: Yes, and moving them is better than pausing. School hours shorten during Ramadan and household evenings restructure around iftar, so a 17:00 slot becomes unworkable for many families while a 21:30 one becomes straightforward. Because Ramadan falls inside the Diploma year, a student who stops for a month loses part of the window where timed-paper practice matters most. Ask for the shifted slot in advance rather than in the first week, because late-evening hours across the northern emirates are the first to fill and a preferred tutor may not have one left.

faqs.question: Does IB Gram send an Economics tutor to an address in Ajman?
faqs.answer: No. IB Gram does not offer home visits anywhere in the UAE; home tutoring is a service offered only in India. All UAE lessons are one-to-one over live video on Gulf Standard Time. For Economics that arrangement helps rather than hinders, because diagrams are built on a shared drawing surface, labels can be removed to test understanding, and every finished diagram is saved into a folder the student revises from. The scheduling gain matters too: the session starts when the student is home rather than when a tutor has crossed Ajman or the Sharjah border.

faqs.question: What does the UAE private tutor permit cost and who can get one?
faqs.answer: It is granted free of charge and runs for two years. The permit was introduced under Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023 and is issued through the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation. Eligible applicants include teachers registered at government or private schools, employees in the government and private sectors, unemployed residents, university students and school students aged fifteen to eighteen. Applications go through the MoHRE website, smart app and e-services system. Anyone tutoring without a permit is subject to fines and penalties under the applicable laws, and no fine schedule is published, so treat specific figures sceptically.

faqs.question: Will a Higher Level Economics grade help with UAE university equivalency?
faqs.answer: Equivalency is a Ministry of Education process assessed against published requirements per curriculum, and it is not something a tutoring platform performs or can accelerate. The British-track rules are published clearly: five accredited GCSE or IGCSE subjects at no less than grade E or 3, with Arabic and Islamic education excluded from that count, plus one A-Level at grade E or two AS-Levels. For the IB, no points threshold should be taken from a tutoring page; verify it on moe.gov.ae or directly with the attestation authority. Tutoring is not a requirement of the process.

ajman/ib-dp-economics-hl-tutor.closingHeading: Bring a marked Paper 2 and a Paper 3 attempt
ajman/ib-dp-economics-hl-tutor.closingBody: Those two documents answer the question a conversation cannot. A marked data-response script shows whether definitions are precise, whether the extracts were used as evidence, whether diagrams carry their labels and whether long answers reach a judgement. A Paper 3 attempt shows whether the arithmetic has been practised at all. Send them, take the free trial lesson, and ask for one diagram and one evaluation question to be marked line by line. Lessons run one-to-one over live video on Gulf Standard Time, timed for an Ajman evening, with later starts for families commuting from Dubai or Sharjah and post-iftar slots through Ramadan.

ajman/ib-dp-extended-essay-tutor.tutorsIntro: The mentors below supervise research essays rather than teach lessons. Each has read enough 4,000-word essays to recognise a research question that will not survive contact with evidence, and each works from what the student has already produced. Ask any of them what they decline to do before you ask about availability.

intro.heading: The one Diploma component with a built-in audit trail
paragraphs: Most of what a parent in Ajman buys in education is invisible until a grade arrives. The Extended Essay is the exception, because the IB has already built the evidence into the assessment. A student must hold three reflection sessions with a school supervisor, record roughly 500 words of reflection across them on a form the supervisor countersigns, and complete a concluding interview known as the viva voce. Those documented reflections are assessed in their own right and carry six of the 34 available marks.

That changes what this page needs to be. There is no need to invent a progress report when the IB mandates one. The useful work is reading the trail that exists: the research question as first registered and as it now stands, the reflections in the student's own words, the supervisor's comment, the current word count against the ceiling, and a draft audited for the one criterion that carries twelve marks. All of that is readable in a single session, and most of it is readable by a parent.

Ajman adds specifics worth planning around. Private schools here are supervised by the federal Ministry of Education rather than an emirate regulator, so internal deadlines are set school by school, and many Ajman students attend campuses in Sharjah or Dubai and follow that calendar instead. The emirate's Diploma cohort is small, which means a supervisor may be carrying essays across several subject groups at once. Mentoring that reads the trail and feeds the supervisor rather than competing with them is the arrangement that works.

Delivery is one-to-one over live video. IB Gram does not send a mentor to an address in Ajman or anywhere else in the UAE; home visits are a service offered only in India. For a research project that is less of a compromise than it sounds, because almost all of the work is a student reading sources and a mentor reading what the student wrote. Screen sharing a draft and a criterion descriptor side by side is in several ways better than two people leaning over one printed page.

The sections that follow take the trail apart in order. Where the 34 marks sit and which of them a late intervention can still reach. The research question log, and what each abandoned version costs in weeks. What the 4,000-word count includes and excludes, which routinely surprises families. How the three reflections and the viva voce are actually assessed. What Ajman students can realistically access for primary data. And the single point in the process where a mentor must refuse, whatever the deadline looks like. Ajman families also want to know how a mentor works alongside a school supervisor without stepping on the role the IB reserves for them, and that boundary is set out below before anything else.
